user.description: Enter the IP address of your Elgato Stream Deck Network Dock. Make sure no other software (Stream Deck app, Companion) is connected to it.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Network Dock.

zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add the Stream Deck Network Dock at {host}?

Attached deck: {deck}

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the dock. Check the address and that no other software is connected to it.

abort.not_network_dock: This device is not a Stream Deck Network Dock.

set_key.name: Set key
set_key.description: Changes what a Stream Deck key shows. The layout is stored and restored after reconnects and restarts.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text shown on the key, may contain line breaks.

font_size.name: Font size
font_size.description: Font size in pixels. Default depends on the key size.

image.name: Image
image.description: Path to an image file on the Home Assistant host, scaled to fill the key.

clear_key.name: Clear key
clear_key.description: Blanks a Stream Deck key and removes its stored appearance.
